observations.seen: Faceted flat-green hill, floating slab runway, 3 rocks, a few cone trees. Two of three frames have no world at all.
The plane is a credible, detailed GLB (~7). Everything else is primitive boxes, cones, and capsules (~2).
The plane livery is fine. Terrain, runway, and rocks are untextured flat albedo.
Plane paint has plausible gloss and a separate canopy material. The world is single-color lambert-looking surfaces.
Nothing in the world reads as a real material. With no environment, even the plane's metal and glass have nothing to reflect.
A single key light and a generic ambient. No "evening" mood despite the brief. No rim or sun direction readable in the void shots.
No visible plane shadow on the runway. The only dark shape is the runway slab's underside. No terrain self-shadowing.
Flat uniform fill. No AO or sky/ground hemisphere tint visible.
Canopy and fuselage show no environment reflection. Glass reads as flat dark teal.
No crushing, but highlights clip hard (white square in the ring) and the overall image is low-contrast and flat.
Colors are coherent (orange hero on blue is good complementary contrast) and sRGB looks correct. The palette is just thin.
Edges are mostly clean at 1080p. Thin streak lines and bollards shimmer-prone (inferred).
Emissive bloom on strips and sprites only. No grading, vignette, DOF, or motion blur. Bloom on the ring blows out.
Line-segment speed streaks and glow dots. No muzzle, contrail, wingtip vortex, or prop disc.
Static-looking discrete dashes and sprites. No visible particle systems.
Bank poses look physically plausible. The prop is rendered as crisp blades with no motion blur or disc, so it reads as frozen.
The plane is the clear hero, well lit enough, and attractive. It is the best thing on screen.
The chase cam loses the ground and horizon entirely in 2 of 3 frames. Distance changes a lot (very close in mid, far in action).
A subject floating in a void. The opening frame is cluttered with a giant clipped ring top-right and random streaks over grass.
With no horizon, fog, ground, or parallax, altitude, speed, and orientation are unreadable.
No fog, haze, clouds, aerial perspective, or sunset sky.
The objective pill is clear, but the ring target is not visible in mid/action and there is no direction indicator. Sprite meaning (drones? sensors?) is unclear.
A clean, consistent dark glass panel with good hierarchy. It reads as a dev control panel, though, and is not diegetic or flight-like.
Legible sans with tidy micro-labels. Generic web-app styling, and debug lines ("Backend rapier", "Flight mode authored") are shipped.
No feedback effects. Debug metadata is visible, and the "action" frame shows no engagement.
Readable layout, but 11 discrete text buttons for a flight game, no HUD stats, and the same empty void.
A good plane in an empty, unlit, unatmospheric scene. Reads as an early prototype.
